purpose: KELIM Convergence Model validation — needs >=3 serial CA-125 in first ~100d of platinum (t0 = first platinum dose)
auth_finding: PDS is a browser-driven SPA portal (all endpoints return identical 654-byte app shell). No public programmatic login API exists. The uploaded credential is an EGA (ega-archive.org) account and authenticated successfully against the EGA IDP — it is NOT an established PDS credential and cannot be validated against PDS from this environment.
access_requirements: PDS Research Access account + signed Data Use Agreement (DUA), obtained via the PDS web portal by the user. Controlled CA-125/outcome data is then downloaded through the portal (not a CLI).

kelim_target_trials.rationale: First-line HGSOC carbo/taxol +/- bevacizumab; per-cycle CA-125; KELIM-validation anchor. HRR outcomes: Norquist BM et al., Clin Cancer Res 2018;24(4):777-783, DOI 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-17-1327.
First-line carbo/taxol +/- bevacizumab; serial CA-125; KELIM developed on first-line trial data.
First-line weekly carbo/taxol; serial CA-125; KELIM literature cohort.

kelim_computation_spec.inputs_required: >=3 CA-125 measurements within first ~100 days of platinum start per patient; t0 = first platinum dose date
kelim_computation_spec.model: KELIM = modeled elimination rate constant of CA-125 from a kinetic (semi-mechanistic exponential-decline) model fit to early serial CA-125
kelim_computation_spec.readout: standardized KELIM (favorable >= threshold) as an on-chemo response biomarker; validated vs PFS/OS
